title: Tensorator and unit of the common-stage completed tensor lift
statement:
theorem completed_tensor_common_lift_tensor_unit
    (N : ∀ E, CompletedTensorFiniteModel l X R closed models E)
    (coherence : RingedDerivedTensorCoherence.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (ProEt.topology X) (ring l X R) closed models symmetry) :
    Nonempty (CompletedTensorCommonLiftTensorUnit l X R closed models symmetry)

source.place: BS Remark 6.8.15; HRS Lemma 7.9; common-field tensor descent.

proof.text: For each finite coefficient field, use the normalized completion and representative square in N E to define the tensor comparison on integral representatives. Transport along the specified common-stage inclusion and use the native tensor comparison in coherence.
The finite comparisons agree under coefficient extension, so they descend to a natural isomorphism on the common-stage category; coefficient multiplication gives the unit isomorphism.
